meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì qǐ. Placed right before the verb to mean 'together' (一起吃晚饭 'have dinner together').

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 这是不行啊。
examples.trans: This is cannot.

examples.text: 那个不行好。
examples.trans: That cannot is good.

meanings.en: in order to; for the sake of
meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi le. Introduces a goal or purpose, typically at the start of the sentence.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi shén me. Asks for a reason; answered with 因为 ('because').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ. Cardinal number 5.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天晚上 ('this evening').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

件.gloss: measure word for tops, luggage, matters

meanings.en: measure word for tops, luggage, matters
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Counts upper-body garments (一件外套), suitcases (一件行李), and affairs (一件事).

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

份.gloss: measure word for portions, copies, jobs

meanings.en: measure word for portions, copies, jobs
meanings.note: Pinyin: fèn. Counts documents, newspapers, meals, and shares (一份文件 'a document').

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 请再给我一份早餐。
examples.trans: Please bring me one more portion of breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封信 ('a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! Your face went completely white! Sit down quickly—what does the letter say?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn fēng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个信封 ('an envelope').

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 桌子上放着一个白色的信封。
examples.trans: A white envelope is lying on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tōu. Before a verb, means 'quietly/secretly' (偷看 'peek secretly').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个儿。
examples.trans: I have a 儿.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的儿。
examples.trans: This is a very good 儿.

入住.gloss: check in, move into (a hotel or residence)

meanings.en: check in, move into (a hotel or residence)
meanings.note: Taking up lodging for an event or trip.

examples.text: 所有参赛歌手都已经入住酒店了。
examples.trans: All competing singers have checked into the hotel.

examples.text: 凭身份证就可以在前台办理入住。
examples.trans: You can check in at the front desk with your ID.

examples.text: 我确实是单身，而且这全城也没有人知道我生日。
examples.trans: I really am single, and nobody in this whole city knows my birthday.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: official correspondence; formal letter from an office or institution
meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng hán. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封公函 (an official letter).

examples.text: 因为市政文化遗产办公室托我把一封正式公函留到今晚再拿出来！
examples.trans: Because the Municipal Heritage Office asked me to hold one official letter until tonight!

examples.text: 那封盖着红章的公函就放在前台木抽屉最上层。
examples.trans: That official letter stamped with a red seal sits in the top drawer of the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐ. Asks about small numbers (几点 'what time', 几个 'how many') before a measure word.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那我也不能不管吧，这怎么办啊？
examples.trans: Well, I cannot just ignore it either — what should I do?

examples.text: 把这件事交给他去办，你完全可以放心。
examples.trans: Leave this matter to him to handle — you can rest completely assured.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn gōng shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间办公室 ('an office').

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 客人对顶楼那间带阳台的客房十分满意。
examples.trans: The guest is very pleased with the top-floor room with the balcony.

examples.text: 老陈做事十分细致，账本上的每一笔数字都清清楚楚。
examples.trans: Old Chen is very meticulous in his work; every single figure in the ledger is crystal clear.

meanings.note: Verb cānjiā.

examples.text: 她参加我们的节目。
examples.trans: She joins our show.

examples.text: 明天谁参加会议？
examples.trans: Who is attending tomorrow's meeting?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu dài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个口袋 ('a pocket').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě. Adds emphatic warmth before an adjective/verb, or means 'but'.

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 今天外面的风可真大。
examples.trans: The wind outside today is really strong.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chī. Everyday verb for eating meals, bread, or snacks.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

meanings.note: noun

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu mò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个周末 ('a weekend').

examples.text: 是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
examples.trans: Who is it? Someone else booking a room for the weekend?

examples.text: 周末早上来院子喝咖啡的人最多。
examples.trans: Weekend mornings bring the biggest crowd to the courtyard for coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí. As a verb, 'return' (回家, 回来); as a measure word, 'occasion/time' (这回 'this time').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn wèi. Introduces a reason; often paired with 所以 ('therefore') in the next clause.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tú. Combines 地 ('earth/land') + 图 ('chart/drawing'); measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 幅 (fú).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 小晴在手绘地图上用红笔标出了过桥以后的绿药店。
examples.trans: On the hand-drawn map, Qing marked the green pharmacy past the bridge in red pen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shuǐ. Liquid writing ink for fountain pens. Measure word: 瓶 (píng, 'bottle').

examples.text: 这页旧信是用深蓝色墨水写的。
examples.trans: This old letter page was written in dark blue ink.

examples.text: 桌上的钢笔没墨水了，我得去加一点。
examples.trans: The fountain pen on the desk is out of ink; I need to refill it.

meanings.en: sound; voice; measure word for sounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Counts cries, knocks, or chimes (一声 'one sound').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài tào. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件外套 ('a coat').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇大门 ('a front gate').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

子.gloss: nominal suffix (forming everyday nouns like 桌子, 椅子, 盘子)

meanings.en: nominal suffix (forming everyday nouns like 桌子, 椅子, 盘子)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zi. Neutral-tone noun suffix attached to roots such as 桌 ('table'), 椅 ('chair'), 盘 ('plate'), and 罐 ('jar').

examples.text: 晚上和周末，我们一起做木桌子和隔音木板！
examples.trans: Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and acoustic panels together!

examples.text: 院子里的木桌子和竹椅子都已经擦得干干净净了。
examples.trans: The wooden tables and bamboo chairs in the courtyard have all been wiped spotless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè zhàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家客栈 ('an inn').

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuān. Describes wide streets, courtyards, or rooms.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used for mailing letters, postcards, or parcels.

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Counts sealed letters and mail items (一封信 'a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xīn. Literally 'small heart'—pay close attention.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn kè zhàn. Eight-room boutique courtyard inn on Wutong Lane in Chengdu.

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 小院客栈，早上好！我是小晴。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn, good morning! This is Qing speaking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chà. Tells minutes 'to' the hour (差五分十二点 'five to twelve') or 'not short a cent' (一分不差).

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

meanings.en: official emblem or coat of arms representing a city
meanings.note: Pinyin: shì huī. Combines 市 (city, municipality) with 徽 (emblem, badge).

examples.text: 快看这个米色信封上的金色市徽！周经理，快拆开看看！
examples.trans: Look at the gold city crest on this cream envelope! Open it right now, Zhou!

examples.text: 市政文化遗产办公室发来的公函，封口印着一朵醒目的金色市徽。
examples.trans: The official letter from the Municipal Heritage Office carried a crisp gold city crest on the seal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì zhèng. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项市政 ('municipal service').

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 市政工人正在修路边的石板。
examples.trans: Municipal workers are repairing the flagstones along the road.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì zhèng tīng. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座市政厅 ('a city hall').

examples.text: 等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
examples.trans: Wait, Zhipeng—you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

座.gloss: measure word for bridges, buildings, mountains

meanings.en: measure word for bridges, buildings, mountains
meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Counts large, fixed structures on a base (一座石桥 'a stone bridge', 一座钟楼 'a clock tower').

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 前面有一座古老的石桥。
examples.trans: There is an old stone bridge ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán qín. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 宋老师？！每星期五教我哥哥弹琴的宋老师？！
examples.trans: Teacher Song?! The Teacher Song who taught my brother piano every Friday?!

examples.text: 每天下午她都在窗边安静地弹琴。
examples.trans: Every afternoon she plays the piano quietly by the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗心 ('a heart').

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì péng. Given name of Zhihao's younger brother.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn. Everyday adjective for slow speed; doubled in 慢慢 ('slowly, take your time').

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

examples.text: 再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
examples.trans: Give it a few more minutes, Mr Zhihao. Midday city traffic is always slow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng dū. Historic southwestern Chinese city famed for courtyards and tea houses.

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个我的。
examples.trans: I have a 我的.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的我的。
examples.trans: This is a very good 我的.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Specifically for accessories placed on the head, face, neck, or wrist—contrast 穿 for clothes/shoes.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: handicraft; culinary or manual skill honed by practice
meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu yì. Praise for cooks, carpenters, calligraphers, and traditional makers.

examples.text: 有琴声、烘焙点心、本地手艺摊儿，还有给全城最暖心院子的金字牌匾！
examples.trans: Music, fresh baking, local craft tables, and a golden plaque for the warmest courtyard in town!

examples.text: 小美烤的浆果杏仁蛋糕越做越香，大家都夸她手艺真棒。
examples.trans: Mei's berry almond cakes turned out even more fragrant, and everyone praised her baking skill.

托.gloss: to entrust; ask someone to deliver

meanings.en: to entrust a message or task to someone; to support on one's palm
meanings.note: Pinyin: tuō. In 托某人做某事, means 'ask someone on one's behalf to carry or handle something.'

examples.text: 哎呀，快看八号房制图老先生托宋老师带进来压轴的东西！
examples.trans: Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker sent in with Teacher Song to crown the box!

examples.text: 因为市政文化遗产办公室托我把一封正式公函留到今晚再拿出来！
examples.trans: Because the Municipal Heritage Office asked me to hold one official letter until tonight!

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

报.gloss: sign up for, enrol in, report

meanings.en: sign up for, enrol in, report
meanings.note: With 培训/班/课, means registering for a course.

examples.text: 她给自己报了一个周末英语班。
examples.trans: She signed herself up for a weekend English class.

examples.text: 同事帮他报了一个短期培训。
examples.trans: A colleague enrolled him in a short training course.

examples.text: 报告情况。
examples.trans: Report the situation.

examples.text: 写报告。
examples.trans: Write a report.

meanings.note: Verb-complement chāikāi ('tear open a parcel or letter').

examples.text: 快递这么重，我来帮你拆开吧。
examples.trans: This parcel is heavy; let me open it for you.

examples.text: 她迫不及待地拆开了生日礼物。
examples.trans: She eagerly unwrapped her birthday present.

examples.text: 义务？跟我谈恋爱，用不着拿出尽义务的心态。
examples.trans: Duty? Dating me doesn't call for the mindset of fulfilling an obligation!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tān. Open-air market table or vendor stall (水果摊 'fruit stall', 陶瓷摊 'pottery stall'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 星期六广场上摆满了卖鲜花和水果的小摊。
examples.trans: On Saturdays, the square is lined with stalls selling fresh flowers and fruit.

examples.text: 转角那个陶瓷摊的茶杯又厚又好看。
examples.trans: The teacups at that pottery stall on the corner are both thick and handsome.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.en: throw wide open; leave wide open
meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎng kāi. Describes gates or windows opened wide.

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 每天早上八点，小院木门准时敞开。
examples.trans: Every morning at eight, the wooden courtyard gates swing wide open.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng gè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 个; modifies singular nouns directly without another measure word (整个中央八度).

examples.text: 修好那根琴槌以后，宋老师给整个中央八度调了音。
examples.trans: After fixing that hammer, Teacher Song tuned the entire middle octave.

examples.text: 柠檬挞的香味飘满了整个咖啡角。
examples.trans: The aroma of lemon tart drifted through the entire café corner.

meanings.note: Noun wénhuà ('culture').

examples.text: 现在的粉丝文化已经很发达了。
examples.trans: Fan culture today has grown very developed.

examples.text: 优秀的电视节目能传播传统文化。
examples.trans: Great television shows help share traditional culture.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén huà jié. Measure word (量词): 届 (jiè) or 个 (gè). Joins 文化 (culture) with 节 (festival).

examples.text: 戴稳眼镜——我来念：诚邀贵客栈参加成都老院文化节！
examples.trans: Glasses set on my nose—let me read: Warmly inviting your inn to join the Chengdu Historic Courtyard Festival!

examples.text: 老院文化节？！整个成都五座深藏的小院子周末一起敞开大门？！
examples.trans: The Historic Courtyard Festival?! Five hidden courtyards across Chengdu opening their gates for one weekend?!

meanings.en: cultural heritage; historic monuments and traditions passed down
meanings.note: Pinyin: wén huà yí chǎn. Pairs 文化 (culture) with 遗产 (legacy, heritage).

examples.text: 因为市政文化遗产办公室托我把一封正式公函留到今晚再拿出来！
examples.trans: Because the Municipal Heritage Office asked me to hold one official letter until tonight!

examples.text: 梧桐巷这几座老木院子，现在成了街坊们共同守护的文化遗产。
examples.trans: These old wooden courtyards on Wutong Lane have become cultural heritage treasured by all the neighbors.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī sān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这星期三 ('this Wednesday').

examples.text: 等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
examples.trans: Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?

examples.text: 每到星期三下午，小美都会试烤新甜点。
examples.trans: Every Wednesday afternoon, Mei test-bakes a new pastry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn. Describes cozy warmth of tea, sunlight, or clothing.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 喝碗热汤，身子一下子就暖了。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup and you warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn dì. Modifies nouns directly or with 的 (本地蜂蜜 'local honey', 本地人 'locals').

examples.text: 集市上卖的全是本地果园早上摘的水果。
examples.trans: Everything sold at the market is fruit picked this morning from local orchards.

examples.text: 本地人最喜欢去转角那家小店喝早茶。
examples.trans: Locals love going to that little shop on the corner for morning tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú tóng xiàng. Tree-lined lane in Chengdu where Courtyard Inn stands.

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn chá. Used for checking pipes, tags, or rooms.

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

examples.text: 谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
examples.trans: Thank you for being so understanding! Chen will check the basement right away.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng shì. Describes formal speech or a permanent job after probation.

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: háo mǐ. Metric unit taking numbers directly without 个.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huó. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件活儿 ('a piece of work').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 手里的活做完就可以休息了。
examples.trans: Once we finish the work in hand, we can rest.

related.gloss: a piece of work (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn. Describes deep breaths (深呼吸) or dark shades of color (深蓝色 'dark blue').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu rén. Measure word: 位 (wèi) politely or 个 (gè), e.g. 几位游人 ('several visitors').

examples.text: 等等——几百位游人顺着梧桐巷走进来，就为了听咱们弹琴、吃小美烤的面包？！
examples.trans: Wait—hundreds of visitors walking down Wutong Lane just for our piano and Mei's fresh bread?!

examples.text: 文化节那天，不少游人站在拱门下听着钢琴声久久不肯走。
examples.trans: On festival day, many visitors lingered under the archway listening to the piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn xin. Literally 点 ('touch lightly') + 心 ('heart'): small baked pastries, cakes, or snacks served with tea; second syllable is neutral tone.

examples.text: 九号房里准备好了新鲜热茶和刚出炉的柠檬点心。
examples.trans: Fresh hot tea and freshly baked lemon pastries are ready inside Room Nine.

examples.text: 客人们喜欢在下午三点坐下来，喝一杯薄荷茶配两块小点心。
examples.trans: Guests love sitting down at three in the afternoon for a cup of mint tea and two small pastries.

meanings.en: to bake pastries or bread; to roast tea or nuts over dry heat
meanings.note: Pinyin: hōng bèi. Standard term for Western-style baking as well as traditional tea roasting.

examples.text: 下午三点？！志鹏，立刻把两台烤箱拧到烘焙温度！
examples.trans: Three in the afternoon?! Peng, crank both ovens up to baking temperature this second!

examples.text: 小美周末常在厨房里试着烘焙各种带着花果香的小点心。
examples.trans: On weekends Mei often experiments in the kitchen baking fragrant fruit-and-flower pastries.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo. Used for baking bread, rolls, and cakes in an oven.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.en: horizontal inscribed wooden plaque or traditional shop signboard
meanings.note: Pinyin: pái biǎn. Measure word: 块 (kuài) or 副 (fù), e.g. 一块金字牌匾 ('a gold-lettered plaque').

examples.text: 有琴声、烘焙点心、本地手艺摊儿，还有给全城最暖心院子的金字牌匾！
examples.trans: Music, fresh baking, local craft tables, and a golden plaque for the warmest courtyard in town!

examples.text: 小院客栈大门上方挂着一块老木牌匾，字迹虽然旧了却依然清楚。
examples.trans: Above the gate of Courtyard Inn hangs an old wooden plaque whose lettering remains clear despite its age.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 她从小就喜欢每天练琴。
examples.trans: She has loved practicing the piano every day since childhood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi. Requires a digit before it in Mandarin (一百 'one hundred', never bare 百 for 100).

examples.text: 留下来跟大家在一起？愿意——一百个愿意！
examples.trans: Stay here together with all of you? Yes—a hundred times yes!

examples.text: 这棵老树已经有一百多年了。
examples.trans: This old tree is already more than a hundred years old.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.en: stare at; keep eyes fixed on
meanings.note: Pinyin: dīng. Usually pairs with 着 (盯着 'staring closely at').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 他盯着墙上的地图看了很久。
examples.trans: He stared at the map on the wall for a long time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.en: take a look; have a quick look
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn kan. Friendly reduplicated form of 看.

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn. Describes holding something steadily or playing music evenly.

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

meanings.note: Verb/noun xiào ('smile, laugh').

examples.text: 你看着我的笔记笑什么？
examples.trans: Why are you smiling at my notes?

examples.text: 听到这个好消息，大家都开心地笑了。
examples.trans: Hearing the good news, everyone smiled happily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dā ying. Means agreeing to a request or giving one's word.

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 既然答应了别人，就一定要准时做到。
examples.trans: Once you give someone your word, be sure to follow through on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐ sè. Joins 米 ('rice') + 色 ('color'). Refers to the pale yellowish color of unpolished rice.

examples.text: 信封是用厚实的米色纸张做的，摸起来很有质感。
examples.trans: The envelope is made of thick beige paper and feels highly textured.

examples.text: 小美今天穿了一件米色的毛衣，显得特别温柔。
examples.trans: Mei wore a beige sweater today, making her look especially gentle.

meanings.en: cannot bear, endure, or survive a test or shock
meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng bù qǐ. Potential complement built from 经 ('endure') + 不 ('not') + 起 ('bear up').

examples.text: 市政厅寄来的正式信件？！慢着，我的小心脏可经不起再来一回检查啦！
examples.trans: An official letter from City Hall?! Hold on, my poor heart cannot survive another inspection!

examples.text: 薄薄的旧纸经不起烈日暴晒，还是挂在屋檐阴凉处更好。
examples.trans: Thin old paper cannot stand harsh direct sun, so it is better hung in the shade under the eaves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: zāng — functions both as a stative adjective (手脏了 hands got dirty) and as a resultative complement after verbs like 弄 or 搞 (弄脏 get something dirty). Note the homograph 脏 (zàng, internal organ).

examples.text: 小谷，对不起啊，把你的本子都弄脏了。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, I am so sorry — I got your notebook all dirty.

examples.text: 那贾喆上午手脏了，他伸手就往我衣服上抹！
examples.trans: That Jia Zhe got dirt on his hand this morning and wiped it straight onto my coat!

related.gloss: to get something dirty; to soil

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jǐ. Follows pronouns to stress 'by oneself' (你自己 'you yourself').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: cáng. Read cáng for 'hide'; often followed by 在 + place (藏在走廊里 'hidden in the hallway').

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

examples.text: 小猫藏在桌子下面。
examples.trans: The kitten is hiding under the table.

蘸.gloss: dip lightly in liquid or sauce

meanings.en: dip lightly in liquid or sauce
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. Used for dipping a sponge in water, a brush in ink/paint, or bread in soup.

examples.text: 先把海绵蘸进温水里，拧半干再去擦玻璃。
examples.trans: Dip the sponge in warm water first and wring it half dry before wiping the glass.

examples.text: 用热脆皮面包蘸着浓番茄汤吃真香呀！
examples.trans: Dipping warm crusty bread into rich tomato soup is delicious!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī jiā. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī), e.g. 二十八个桦木衣夹 ('twenty-eight birch clothespins').

examples.text: 走，下楼吧——前台还有三十个木衣夹等着小晴呢。
examples.trans: Come on downstairs—I have thirty wooden clothespins waiting for Qing at the front desk.

examples.text: 小晴把九号衣夹放进铁盒前，先让院子里的每个人都在背面签了名。
examples.trans: Before placing clothespin number nine into the tin box, Qing had everyone in the courtyard sign its back.

meanings.en: to praise, commend, or give public credit to
meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎo yáng. Everyday word for formal recognition as well as warm encouragement.

examples.text: 放宽心，周经理——还记得星期三那份表扬九号房和院子的文化报告吗？
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou—remember that Wednesday heritage report praising Room Nine and your courtyard?

examples.text: 宋老师当众表扬志豪这次不抢拍了，弹得比从前稳重多了。
examples.trans: Teacher Song praised Hao aloud for not rushing the tempo this time, playing far more steadily than before.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì de. Describes recalling something from memory.

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 这么多年过去了，您还记得？
examples.trans: After all these years, you still remember that?

meanings.en: to cordially or sincerely invite (formal invitation wording)
meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng yāo. Standard opening on official invitations, posters, and festival letters.

examples.text: 戴稳眼镜——我来念：诚邀贵客栈参加成都老院文化节！
examples.trans: Glasses set on my nose—let me read: Warmly inviting your inn to join the Chengdu Historic Courtyard Festival!

examples.text: 邀请函末尾还写着诚邀各位老邻居周末前来品茶听琴。
examples.trans: At the bottom of the invitation, it cordially invited all longtime neighbors to drop by this weekend for tea and piano music.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì. Opposite of 便宜 ('cheap'); 太贵了 ('too expensive') is the classic market complaint.

examples.text: 这张老照片我真喜欢，可是新的家具太贵了！
examples.trans: I truly love this old photo, but new furniture costs a fortune!

examples.text: 周经理，谁说要买很贵的新家具了？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, who said anything about buying expensive new furniture?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 我们不用电脑，一直用这个大纸本子记账。
examples.trans: We do not use a computer; we always use this big paper ledger to keep accounts.

examples.text: 这个木头小火车是老木匠专门为孩子们做的礼物。
examples.trans: This little wooden train is a gift made specially for the children by the old carpenter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn lái. Friendly invitation 请进来 ('please come in').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块金子 ('a piece of gold').

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 阳光下，铜招牌闪着金光。
examples.trans: In the sunlight, the brass sign gleamed gold.

related.gloss: a piece of gold (measure word 块)

meanings.en: gold leaf; paper-thin hammered gold foil used in painting and gilding
meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn bó. Measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 片 (piàn) for a sheet of foil.

examples.text: 正中央用暖暖的金箔画着的，就是咱们小院客栈和九号房！
examples.trans: And right in the center, painted in warm gold leaf, sits Courtyard Inn and Room Nine!

examples.text: 这封邀请函上的市徽印着细腻的金箔，拿在手里格外庄重。
examples.trans: The city crest on this invitation is stamped in delicate gold leaf, feeling wonderfully grand in hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种金色 ('a golden color').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座钟 ('a clock').

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

examples.text: 大堂墙上的老钟敲了十二下。
examples.trans: The old clock on the lobby wall struck twelve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng fēng. Pairs 防 ('guard against') + 风 ('wind').

examples.text: 先救灯笼，再解决防风座位——有我在，谁都别慌。
examples.trans: Rescue the lanterns first, solve the windproof seats second—with me here, nobody panic.

examples.text: 用桦木衣夹把餐巾夹好以后，整张院子餐桌立刻变得既防风又整齐。
examples.trans: Once the napkins were clipped with birch clothespins, every courtyard table looked windproof and neat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 前院种着花草，后院十分安静。
examples.trans: Flowers grow in the front yard, and the back courtyard is quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片面包 ('a slice of bread').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

related.gloss: a slice of bread (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shùn zhe. Preposition 顺 ('follow along in the same direction') + continuous particle 着 (顺着走廊吹 'blow down the hallway', 顺着木纹刷 'brush along the wood grain').

examples.text: 小晴顺着木纹薄薄地刷油漆，刷出来的窗板又平整又漂亮。
examples.trans: Qing brushed the paint thinly along the wood grain, giving the shutters a smooth, even finish.

examples.text: 顺着梧桐巷的青石板路一直往前走，就能看见九号房的木牌。
examples.trans: Walk straight along the flagstones of Wutong Lane and you will spot the wooden sign for Room Nine.

meanings.note: Used as resultative complement (买齐/到齐) meaning nothing missing.

examples.text: 单子上列的东西，我跑了好几趟全都给你买齐了。
examples.trans: After several trips, I bought every single item on your list.

examples.text: 参会人员都已经到齐了，咱们现在开始开会吧。
examples.trans: Everyone for the meeting is here—let us get started.
